Marcus recently adjusted the Tuesday session from 7 AM to 6:30 AM due to a new client at 7:30 AM; Thursday sessions remain at 7 AM. He uses a calm, conversational coaching style focused on explaining the reasoning behind exercises, which the client prefers over more intense methods.
